content: Mobile web media a11y baseline 2026: WCAG 2.5.8 min tap target 24x24 CSS px (AA), 44x44 recommended (AAA); aria-live=polite for status/roll announcements so as not to interrupt; prefers-reduced-motion must disable/replace animations; visible keyboard focus indicators and full keyboard operability expected for media players (W3C WAI media player pattern).
